# yxml

Unmodified yxml.c, yxml.h and COPYING from the getdnsapi mirror, commit
`57497cdcacb6e5538e6bf6dad0b274896d9b3962`.

- Upstream: https://dev.yorhel.nl/yxml
- Mirror: https://github.com/getdnsapi/yxml/tree/57497cdcacb6e5538e6bf6dad0b274896d9b3962
- Copyright (c) 2013-2014 Yoran Heling, MIT; see COPYING.

Used only for bounded RSS parsing. HisuOS rejects DTD/entity declarations,
unknown entities, excessive nesting, malformed/truncated XML and oversized feeds.
No HTML evaluation, external entity resolver or article downloader is provided.
